Data and model assumptions

The dataset is a fixed random subset of filtered cells from 10x Genomics Donor 1. Reference cell labels are absent from this fit. The marker list supplies the candidate type names. PCA uses the selected expression panel for display, and EM uses raw counts from seven markers with each cell’s full-library total as a depth offset.

This teaching implementation is inspired by CellAssign. It uses a fixed negative-binomial size of 2, and learns a background expression rate and a marker-enriched rate for each gene. Enriched rates are constrained to be at least the background rates. Unassigned uses the background rates for all markers. The E-step computes all four responsibilities and the M-step updates rates and proportions. Fit is judged within this model.

The optional review computes a separate PCA that excludes the first-round marker genes. It needs at least five anchors per biological type. A cell is marked as supported when the winning type agrees with the first-round leader, has probability at least 90% in the review model, and falls within the anchor-based distance limit. The review is a cross-check on the same cells.
